# MindAR Image Target Directory

Place your compiled `.mind` target file here:

`public/targets/cards.mind`

### How to generate cards.mind:
1. Go to [MindAR Image Target Compiler](https://hiukim.github.io/mind-ar-js-doc/tools/compile).
2. Upload your flat card artwork image file (PNG or JPG format).
3. Click **Start** and then **Download** `targets.mind`.
4. Rename/Save the file to `public/targets/cards.mind`.
